name: Huaxiadraco
sum: Crested tapejarid from the Aptian Jiufotang Formation of Chaoyang, Liaoning — formerly ‘Huaxiapterus’ corollatus.
holotype: ZMNH M8131 — Jiufotang Formation, Chaoyang, Liaoning.
material: Nearly complete skeleton; several further specimens referred (D2525, BMPC 103–105).
biology: Toothless tapejarid; relatives such as Sinopterus show evidence of a plant-based diet.
author: Pêgas et al. 2023
